items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Zilher T. Randolph was musical director. And with George E. Lee... This was in my really learning days.

ctx.x: You had permission to write these things, yes.

Louig Armstrong, you know, I told you about this 'Sweet Sue' and a few different other things we recorded, like 'The World on A String' and all of these different things that we recorded with Louie in '33. I did a lot of writing in there, although Zilher T. Randolph was musical
director. And with George E. Lee, oh, gee, I must have written many, many, many little arrangements. This was in my really learning days.
